title: Séance
summary: Sealed group polls with anonymous eligibility, replaceable ballots and scheduled reveal. November 5 review: the public browser interface loads, while both historical Esmeralda polls fall back to explicitly labeled recorded snapshots; their component addresses are not found in the current explorer after the testnet reset. Radicle source a1ef9667 remains available with no published releases; its README pins template library 0.34.0 and test tooling 0.46.1. The creator’s October proof and test counts describe historical runs. The November 5 recording tours the browser interface and its explicit historical snapshot fallback, separately from chain voting; earlier October footage is preserved in the media history. Fee-pot contributions cannot be withdrawn. Lost receipts prevent counting, revealed choices become public, and timing or funding links can expose information. MIT source; Esmeralda testnet.
